musique.description:
Global Metadata: cinematic electronic, nocturnal pulse to sunrise anthem, 100 BPM, Opens with a lone ticking synth pulse and soft notification-like plucks, deep sub bass; builds with a shimmering arpeggiator and tight muted drums; drops to felt piano and airy pads for the sleeping night; a long string swell at dawn; a riser into a full euphoric drop with wide drums, bright synth lead, choir pad; resolves on warm piano and strings. Clean modern mix, strong transients on the hits, no vocals. Loud polished master.

Vocal Details: Instrumental, no lyrics, no vocals, no choir.

Arrangement: [Intro nuit] at 0 seconds: lone ticking synth pulse, sparse plucks piling up, sub bass drone, tension [Montée] at 2 seconds: hard hit, shimmering arpeggiator enters, muted kick and hats, forward momentum [Groove] at 10 seconds: full groove, snare on hits, rhythmic stabs synced to cuts [Berceuse] at 16 seconds: drums drop out, felt piano melody and airy pads, intimate and tender [Aube] at 20 seconds: slow string swell, warm brass pad, light breaking, hopeful [Attente] at 26 seconds: riser and ticking pulse return, held breath, tension building [Envol] at 31 seconds: euphoric drop, wide drums, bright synth lead, choir pad, release [Résolution] at 38 seconds: drums fall away, warm piano and strings resolve the theme [Fin] at 42 seconds: final sustained chord, soft tail Strong hits at 2.4, 9.6, 15.6, 20.4, 30.6, 38.4, 42.0 seconds. Clean ending at 48 seconds.
